<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<plist xmlns="urn:neutral:property-list"
       xmlns:portable="urn:neutral:source-metadata"
       portable:document="preserve"
       version="1.0">
  <dict portable:container="north">
    <key portable:identity="message">dock.namespace</key>
    <dict portable:ownership="protected">
      <key portable:identity="format">NSStringLocalizedFormatKey</key>
      <string portable:note="keep">%#@signals@ across sheltered water</string>
      <key portable:identity="plural">signals</key>
      <dict portable:ownership="plural">
        <key portable:identity="type">NSStringFormatSpecTypeKey</key>
        <string portable:note="platform">NSStringPluralRuleType</string>
        <key portable:identity="value-type">NSStringFormatValueTypeKey</key>
        <string portable:note="platform">ld</string>
        <key portable:identity="singular">one</key>
        <string portable:note="translate">%ld harbor signal</string>
        <key portable:identity="plural">other</key>
        <string portable:note="translate"><![CDATA[%ld harbor signals]]></string>
        <key portable:identity="protected-rule">futureRulePriority</key>
        <integer portable:note="rule-owned">11</integer>
      </dict>

      <key portable:identity="protected-message">futurePriority</key>
      <integer portable:note="message-owned">7</integer>
      <key portable:identity="protected-array">futureFlags</key>
      <array portable:note="platform-owned">
        <true portable:flag="first" />
        <false portable:flag="second"></false>
        <string portable:note="untouched">Protected & stable</string>
      </array>
    </dict>
  </dict>
</plist>
